questions.question: The repository has four layers: multiprocess_framework, Services, Plugins, multiprocess_prototype. Write the allowed import direction as one chain `X -> Y -> Z -> W`, where `X -> Y` means X may import Y (reverse imports are forbidden). Answer in the `answer` field; `locations` may be empty.
questions.note: Format-instructed chain so a substring match is deterministic.

questions.question: In `multiprocess_prototype/backend/topology/inspection_full.yaml`, in which process does `ColorMaskPlugin` run, and which `process_class` hosts it? Answer in the `answer` field; `locations` may be empty.
questions.note: Interpretation: the brief says 'framework module'; a topology hosts plugins, so a plugin is asked.

questions.question: Name the classes a dict message passes through from `send_message` in process A to the handler in process B: the message class, its adapter, the router class, the channel class; and the module that supplies the queues. Answer in the `answer` field; `locations` may be empty.
questions.note: The bare fact 'Message' was removed: whole-word matching ignores case, so the word in the question text satisfied it.

questions.question: Which public names does `config_module` export in its `__all__` (give all of them)? Answer in the `answer` field; `locations` may be empty.
questions.note: __all__ = Config, ConfigManager, ConfigManagerConfig, ConfigSection, IConfigManager, IConfig (6). Facts match whole words, so 'ConfigManager' and 'IConfig' no longer hide inside longer names. Still weak: the question does not ask for the count (6), so a partial list is judged by name only.

questions.question: Which interface does `ConfigManager` implement, and how many abstract members does that interface have in total, own plus inherited? Answer in the `answer` field; `locations` may be empty.
questions.note: 17 = 7 own (config_module/interfaces.py) + 10 in IBaseManager (@abstractmethod count between class lines, git show 1dc6c71b7).

questions.question: Which three units import `router_module` most (production code, not tests; count import statements per unit, unit = a directory under `multiprocess_framework/modules/` or a subpackage of `multiprocess_prototype/`)? Answer in the `answer` field; `locations` may be empty.
questions.note: git grep -n -E '^\s*(from|import) [A-Za-z_.]*router_module' 1dc6c71b7 -- '*.py', minus tests and router_module itself: process_module 14, frontend_module 3, multiprocess_prototype/frontend 3, process_manager_module 2, five singles. Counted by git grep, not taken from docs/arch-map/model.json.

questions.question: How does a plugin get its configuration: which base class carries the config schema, which class method names the plugin's config class, and which object hands the YAML values to the plugin? Answer in the `answer` field; `locations` may be empty.

Which named worker threads does `process_module` start in a generic process (system threads, heartbeat, data intake, pipeline, source producers)? Give the worker names. Answer in the `answer` field; `locations` may be empty.
questions.note: data_receiver, pipeline_executor and source_producer_<plugin> are created under conditions in generic_process.py.

questions.question: Which function in which file resolves the pipeline (topology) file the app boots with: from the manifest or from a CLI override? Answer in the `answer` field; `locations` may be empty.
questions.note: Interpretation: the brief says 'recipes choose the topology'; at 1dc6c71b7 the choice is _resolve_pipeline (CLI override > app.pipeline); recipes live in app.recipes.

questions.question: What is the difference between a process name and a Router channel (see `ROUTING_GLOSSARY.md`)? Which of them is the argument of `send_message`, what is a channel bound to, and must the two coincide? Also name the example channel the glossary gives for the `draw` register. Answer in the `answer` field; `locations` may be empty.
questions.note: No option may appear in the question text: the send_message fact was removed; control_draw is asked for explicitly.
